clue.text: Spreading mould

blocks.note: first meaning: scattering or throwing out, as seed or a net
second meaning: an object formed in a mould, or the moulding process

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests fungus growing across a surface; the two words are separate meanings of one word.
explanation.definitionFit: To cast is to throw widely, as with seed, and a metal object shaped in a mould is a cast product.

clue.text: Orderly system requires rating to support two army officers

blocks.note: CO is commanding officer and SM sergeant major
OS is ordinary seaman, a naval rating

explanation.surface: A tidy organisation needs a sailor to back up a pair of military commanders.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, 'to support' puts the rating beneath the officers.
explanation.definitionFit: The cosmos is the universe seen as a harmonious, ordered whole, the opposite of chaos.

clue.text: Youngster hesitates when bringing up the rear

indicators.note: in a down entry, bringing the rear up means the final letter is lifted to the top

blocks.note: to haver is to dither or hesitate, chiefly British

explanation.surface: A child dawdles while trailing at the back.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry the last letter is lifted to the top. A young shaver is an old term for a boy.
explanation.definitionFit: Shaver is a dated informal word for a young lad, usually as young shaver.

clue.text: Crazy numbers may be so

blocks.note: first meaning: not reasonable or sane
second meaning: numbers not expressible as fractions, like pi

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests mad sums; the second part is the mathematical term.
explanation.definitionFit: Unreasonable behaviour is called this, and mathematicians use it for numbers that cannot be written as a ratio.

clue.text: Type of spirit – a drop of rum for yours truly!

indicators.note: one thing given for another means it is swapped in as a replacement

blocks.note: a genie is a spirit, as from a lamp
the first letter of rum
yours truly is the setter, I

explanation.surface: A kind of liquor: a little rum, just for me!
explanation.walkthrough: The R takes the place of the I in the spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: A genre is a category or kind, especially of art or literature, so a noun synonym of type.

clue.text: Conserve kind of port bottled by worker

indicators.note: something bottled is sealed inside a container, so one part sits within the other

blocks.note: a hand is a manual worker
a USB port on a computer

explanation.surface: Someone preserving a type of fortified wine in bottles prepared by a labourer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' tempts you towards wine or harbours; it is the computer socket.
explanation.definitionFit: To husband resources is to use them sparingly and save them, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Abrupt Cornishman composed musical study

indicators.note: abrupt means cut short, so the word loses its last letter
composed means put together or arranged, so the letters are set in a new order

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A curt man from Cornwall wrote a piece of music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Composed' reads as calm or as writing music; it signals rearranging the shortened word.
explanation.definitionFit: Harmonics is the study of musical sound and overtones, a branch of acoustics in music theory.

clue.text: Plunder pleated fabric

blocks.note: first meaning: stolen goods, loot
second meaning: a draped curtain festoon

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests stealing cloth; it is two meanings of one word.
explanation.definitionFit: Burglars' loot is called this, and so is a decorative draped length of fabric over a window.

clue.text: Acerbic relative contracts ordinary blood complaint

indicators.note: to contract an illness is to take it in, so the pair takes a letter inside

blocks.note: acid means sharp or biting in tone
sis is short for sister
O is the abbreviation for ordinary

explanation.surface: A sharp-tongued family member catches an everyday disease of the blood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contracts' reads as catching an illness, which suits the medical surface, but it is the signal for taking something in.
explanation.definitionFit: Acidosis is a medical condition with excessive acid in the blood and body fluids.

clue.text: Skilfully replacing old rendering for house

indicators.note: replacing means one thing takes the place of another within the word

blocks.note: doing something well is doing it skilfully
O is the abbreviation for old
rendering a service is doing it

explanation.surface: A builder expertly renews the old plaster render of a house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rendering' tempts as plaster on walls; it means performing.
explanation.definitionFit: A dwelling is a place where people live, a home, so a noun synonym of house.

clue.text: Flight member – one welcomed by major

indicators.note: someone welcomed is taken in, so one part is placed inside the other

blocks.note: a major performer or player is a star
Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An airline crew member greets a single passenger, welcomed aboard by a military major.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flight' reads as air travel, but it is a flight of stairs.
explanation.definitionFit: A staircase is called a flight, and each single step in it is one unit of that flight.

clue.text: Report mother cuddling a senior cleric

indicators.note: to cuddle is to hold in one's arms, so the outer word wraps around the other

blocks.note: as in mother tongue, one's native language
taken as written
RR is Right Reverend, the title of a bishop

explanation.surface: A news report of a mother hugging a bishop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mother' means native as in mother tongue, not a parent. RR, Right Reverend, is the style of an Anglican bishop.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrative is an account or story of events, a noun synonym of report.

clue.text: Where troops may be sent too much

blocks.note: first meaning: out of the trenches into attack, in First World War language
second meaning: excessive, overdone

explanation.walkthrough: In the First World War soldiers climbed out of the trench parapet to attack; the phrase now also means excessive.
explanation.definitionFit: Going over the parapet was the infantry charge, and the idiom for exaggerated behaviour grew from it.

clue.text: Announced scientist's gathering

indicators.note: announced means spoken out to listeners, so the word is taken by its sound

blocks.note: Robert Boyle, the chemist of Boyle's law

explanation.surface: A scientist's conference was publicly announced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gathering' looks like a meeting; here it is a swelling full of pus, which is said to gather.
explanation.definitionFit: A boil is an inflamed pus-filled swelling, and such an abscess is traditionally called a gathering.

clue.text: Pet creates struggles for runner

indicators.note: something that struggles twists and writhes, so the letters are thrown into a new order

blocks.note: the ten letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A beloved animal makes trouble for an athlete.
explanation.definitionFit: A pacesetter is a runner who leads to set the speed for others in a race.

clue.text: Opticians not trained to see this condition

indicators.note: untrained means undisciplined and out of order, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Untrained eye specialists are being consulted for some ailment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Condition' suggests an eye problem given the opticians, but it is a bowel complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: Constipation is a medical state of difficult bowel movement, so it is a bodily condition.

clue.text: Ring up apothecary to get view about fixative

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top
about means around, so the outer word encloses the rest

blocks.note: to view is to see
to toll a bell is to ring it
ap. is the dictionary abbreviation for apothecary

explanation.surface: Phone the chemist to get an opinion on a hair gel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ring up' reads as phoning; here it puts the bell sound upwards. Sellotape is the British brand name for clear sticky tape.
explanation.definitionFit: Sellotape is adhesive tape, something used to fix things together, hence a fixative.

clue.text: Flannel and gentle Pears?

blocks.note: gentle means soft
Pears is a British soap brand; the question mark marks the example

explanation.surface: A washcloth and a mild bar of Pears soap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flannel' looks like a face cloth, but it is British slang for flattery or smooth talk.
explanation.definitionFit: Soft soap is flattering persuasive talk, and flannel in British usage is the same kind of evasive flattery.

clue.text: Bristle over bank's reserve

blocks.note: a seta is a bristle, in biology
a riverbank is its side

explanation.surface: Someone bristles at a bank's financial reserves.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'over' places the bristle on top. Seta is the zoological term for a bristle.
explanation.definitionFit: To set aside money is to save it for later use, keeping it in reserve.

clue.text: Tosca and Norma maybe holding good theatre accessories

indicators.note: holding means having something inside, so one piece goes within the other

blocks.note: Tosca and Norma are heroines of operas, so opera lasses
G is the abbreviation for good

explanation.surface: Two divas performing title roles hold something good for theatregoers.
explanation.walkthrough: Tosca and Norma are title heroines of operas by Puccini and Bellini, so 'maybe' marks them as examples of girls from opera.
explanation.definitionFit: Opera glasses are small binoculars carried by audience members to see the stage.

clue.text: Lovin' American stars

blocks.note: caring with its final letter dropped, as the apostrophe shows
A is the abbreviation for American

explanation.surface: A Hollywood star who is lovin' it.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in 'Lovin'' asks for the word that means it to lose its G too.
explanation.definitionFit: Carina is a southern constellation, the Keel, so it is a group of stars.

clue.text: Curse the French tool

blocks.note: a pest is a bane or curse
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Swearing at a French implement.
explanation.definitionFit: A pestle is the club-shaped implement used with a mortar to pound and grind.

clue.text: Foley artist returns carrying charger

indicators.note: carrying means the phrase holds the word within its letters
something that returns goes back the way it came, so it is read backwards

blocks.note: found running across the end of the first word and into the second

explanation.surface: A sound-effects artist comes back carrying a phone charger.
explanation.walkthrough: A Foley artist creates film sound effects. A charger is an old word for a large flat serving dish.
explanation.definitionFit: A charger is a large flat plate or platter, and a tray is a similar flat carrying dish.

clue.text: Delayed reaction when drink engulfs retiring princess

indicators.note: to engulf is to swallow up, so the drink surrounds the other part
retiring means withdrawing or going back, so the name is read backwards

blocks.note: a double is a twice-sized measure of spirits
Kate, the Princess of Wales

explanation.surface: A slow response comes when a stiff drink swallows a royal who is withdrawing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retiring' sounds like a shy princess, but it is the signal for turning her name round.
explanation.definitionFit: A double take is a late second look of surprise, a belated response to something seen.

clue.text: Ray eats a bit of rancid fish

indicators.note: eating something takes it inside, so one part goes within the other
a small bit of a word is its opening letter alone

blocks.note: a ray of light is a beam
first letter of rancid

explanation.surface: A stingray devours some rotten fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ray' looks like the fish, but it is a beam of light; the fish is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A bream is a freshwater or sea fish, so the answer is an example of a fish.

clue.text: File railway stock story

blocks.note: first meaning: a row of people, as in single file
another meaning: a railway route or track
another meaning: ancestry or lineage
last meaning: a spiel or account

explanation.walkthrough: Four separate meanings of one short word, strung together to read like a share-trading tale.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a row or queue, a rail route, a family descent and a glib story.

clue.text: Start of emigration with million going abroad

indicators.note: going means leaving, so that letter departs from the word
abroad can mean astray or all over the place, so the letters are scattered

blocks.note: taken as written
M is the abbreviation for million

explanation.surface: The beginning of mass emigration, a million people heading overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Start of' looks like a first-letter signal, but Start is the definition and 'of' a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To originate is to begin or come into being, so it is a verb synonym of start.

clue.text: After new beginning maybe Mark becomes mark

indicators.note: a new beginning means the opening letter is exchanged for a different one

blocks.note: St Mark the evangelist is an example of a saint

explanation.surface: A man called Mark makes a fresh start and turns into a target.
explanation.walkthrough: The saint's first letter is swapped for a new one, S becoming T.
explanation.definitionFit: A taint is a stain or trace of corruption, a blemish left on something, so a mark.

clue.text: Lead Edward in exercise around sports area

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so the exercise letters enclose the rest
in means placed inside, so the name goes within the outer letters

blocks.note: PE is physical education
a rec is a recreation ground
Ed is short for Edward

explanation.surface: A man named Edward takes the lead in a workout around a playing field.
explanation.walkthrough: A rec is a British public recreation ground or park, and PE is school physical education.
explanation.definitionFit: To precede is to go before, so a verb synonym of lead in the sense of being in front.

clue.text: Minor is half-cut attending English resort

indicators.note: cutting a word in half keeps only its first half

blocks.note: minor means marginal, whose first half is kept
attending a place is being at it
E is the abbreviation for English

explanation.surface: An underage drinker is tipsy while visiting a seaside town in England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Half-cut' is British slang for tipsy, but here it means cut in half. Margate is a seaside resort in Kent.
explanation.definitionFit: Margate is a traditional seaside holiday town on the Kent coast of England, so it is an example.
